read.thesis: Dow's Q4 2024 call shows capex cut by $300-500M to hold near current levels, $1B cost cuts and a European cracker idling, while Q1 EBITDA guided down to about $1B on feedstock squeeze.

utilisation.quote: I'd say the operating rates in the Americas continue to be relatively strong. So you're talking about high 80s, low-90s percent types of operating rates.

capex.quote: we're going to... reducing our 2025 spending by $300 million to $500 million compared to our previously disclosed target of $3.5 billion.

triggers.label: CapEx cut $300-500M vs $3.5B
triggers.quote: reducing our 2025 spending by $300 million to $500 million compared to our previously disclosed target of $3.5 billion

triggers.label: European cracker idled from Q2
triggers.quote: This decision will result in us idling this asset starting in second quarter until market dynamics improve.

triggers.label: Q1 EBITDA guided to about $1B
triggers.quote: We expect first quarter earnings to be approximately $1 billion, down $200 million quarter-over-quarter.

triggers.label: Local price down 3% YoY and QoQ
triggers.quote: Local price was down 3% year-over-year and sequentially with declines across all our operating segments.

triggers.label: Industry oversupply, China siloxane capacity
triggers.quote: we're continuing to see an overcapacity situation there

guidance.quote: We expect first quarter earnings to be approximately $1 billion, down $200 million quarter-over-quarter.
we anticipate our operational tax-rate to be in the range of 25% to 29%
We announced today that we will implement cost reductions of $1 billion on an annual run-rate basis by 2026.
We just provided a guide on the CapEx now in the range of $3 billion to $3.2 billion.
the project is expected to generate approximately $1 billion in incremental EBITDA annually by 2030.

red_flags.label: Cash conversion 67%, FCF $44M vs $2B dividend
red_flags.quote: Free Cash Flow -- $44 million, based on $811 million in cash flow from continuing operations and $767 million in total CapEx.

red_flags.label: Margins unsustainable, price hikes at risk
red_flags.quote: Margins have reached a place that they are unsustainable.

evasions.quote: I just want to reiterate that it is really important that we are going to stand firm on our price increases.

evasions.topic: Whether European closures offset new capacity
evasions.quote: I don't want you to assume that's the answer to the European strategic review
